subject: SignalOps discovery recap and next-step timing
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@signalops.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T22:03:00-08:00
Subject: SignalOps discovery recap and proposed next steps

Hi Tom — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from my side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Key pain: unpredictable inference costs and occasional tail latency spikes during batch jobs.
- Scope: a pilot for your alerting/ingestion pipeline (~3 models, mixed seq lengths) to run for 4 weeks.
- Success criteria: 25% token-cost reduction vs current infra and p95 latency < 400ms during 90th percentile load.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send an outline M.A.P. (attached) and a short pricing range for dedicated pilot capacity.
2) Markus (cc) to confirm technical checklist and any initial compatibility items.
3) Tentative scheduling: kickoff 11/30 if that still works for you.

Can you confirm: a) pilot scope looks right, and b) 11/30 kickoff is feasible for your team?

Thanks — speak soon.

—
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: 20261116-signalops-map-v1.pdf

Date: 2026-11-18T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SignalOps discovery recap and proposed next steps

Thanks Ava — this aligns with what we discussed. Couple of quick Qs: 
- Can you share the expected billing cadence for a short pilot (monthly vs prorated)?
- Can the pilot include an isolated VPC option — data residency is something we need to check with security.

I’ll loop in procurement if we decide to move forward.

Tom
Head of Engineering, SignalOps
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SignalOps discovery recap and proposed next steps

Tom — quick follow as we haven't heard back on the two items you flagged (billing cadence and VPC).

Short answers: billing is monthly with prorated first-month usage; we can offer a VPC/private deployment for pilots with a short checklist (security review required). I'll bring documents.

If you want, we can push kickoff into early December — what makes the most sense for your schedule?

If I don't hear back by EOD next Wednesday, I'll follow up again.

Best,
Ava

--

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Ready to bump SignalOps? Quick alignment before I re-contact

Team — Tom has not replied to my last follow-up. Before I send a short re-engagement note, two asks so we present a single front: 

1) Technical: Markus — confirm whether a VPC pilot is a standard Private deployment (docs/approx 3–5 business days for environment prep) or if we need an on-prem-esque configuration. Any blockers we should call out?
2) CS/Onboarding: Laura — if they sign for a 4-week pilot, what resources do you want to commit for kickoff and week-of-support (hours and <1wk SLA)?
3) Pricing/Discount: Aditya — would you approve a pilot credit or a one-time discount if procurement pushes on scope? Suggestion: up to 15% pilot credit to keep it moving.

I plan to send a brief two-line bump to Tom tomorrow morning that includes an ask for decision by 12/03 or to propose alternatives. Goal is to avoid over-emailing while keeping the deal warm.

Thanks — please reply with one-line bullets so I can fold into the external message.

—
Ava
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Ava — quick notes:
- VPC pilot: doable. Standard Private deployment profile should cover it; estimate 3 business days to stand up with our infra team.
- No infra blockers expected based on the models they described; I'll need the model formats and typical sequence lengths before kickoff.

Markus
Senior Solutions Engineer

Ava — we can allocate a 4-hour kickoff block + 2x 1-hour office hours during week 1. If they want 24/7 escalation during pilot, that's an additional paid add-on.

For pricing, I'm flexible on a small pilot credit — up to 10% from my side, prefer to keep 15% if Aditya signs off.

Laura
Customer Success Manager

Subject: Quick touch: pilot timing and VPC check-in

Hi Tom — wanted to do a quick, short check-in. We're ready on our side to move forward with the pilot and can support a private/VPC deployment. To keep this concise: 

- Pilot outline attached (MAP).
- Billing: monthly, prorated first month.
- Support: kickoff (4h) + 2 office hours in week 1 (CS: Laura cc'd).
- Infra prep: Markus estimates ~3 business days for VPC provisioning.

Would you be able to confirm by Friday 12/03 whether you want to proceed with the 11/30 kickoff or if early December is better? If procurement needs to be included, happy to loop them in.

If this isn't a priority right now, a one-line reply is fine — appreciate any signal so we don't over-email.

Best,
